name: CMH SmartCopy Lite
author: codemasterhub

sections.description:
CMH SmartCopy Lite adds configurable copy buttons to code blocks and other selectors. It supports Text Only, HTML Only, and Smart Copy formats, appearance controls, display conditions, a basic manual copy shortcode, and privacy-aware analytics.

The plugin stores settings in WordPress options and copy analytics in a small custom table. Copied content is not stored.

CMH SmartCopy Pro is a separate add-on for advanced copy workflows such as a visual shortcode builder, exportable reports, business helpers, and additional clipboard formats.

Support: CodeMaster Hub Support
Documentation: SmartCopy Documentation
Pro add-on: CMH SmartCopy Pro

Free Features

  • Rule-based automatic copy buttons.
  • Copy formats: Text Only, HTML Only, Smart Copy.
  • Appearance controls for labels, positions, colors, radius, font size, padding, icon behavior, and custom classes.
  • Visibility conditions for public post types, page or post IDs, and logged-in status.
  • Basic manual shortcode for simple text values.
  • Privacy-aware analytics by rule and page.
  • Tooltip and notification styling controls for copy buttons.

Optional Pro Add-On

CMH SmartCopy Pro is an optional separate add-on hosted by CodeMaster Hub. It adds advanced shortcode workflows, exportable analytics reports, business copy helpers, and additional clipboard formats.

Learn more: CMH SmartCopy Pro

Browser Notes

CMH SmartCopy Lite uses the modern Clipboard API when available and falls back to plain text copying when the browser blocks richer clipboard writes.

Privacy

CMH SmartCopy Lite records event metadata such as rule ID, page URL, format, and time. Copied content is never stored by default.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cmh-smartcopy-lite folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Smart Copy in the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does CMH SmartCopy Lite store the copied content?

No. CMH SmartCopy Lite stores copy event metadata such as the rule, page, format, and time, but it does not store the copied content itself.

Why is a copy button not showing on the frontend?

Make sure the rule is enabled, the target selectors match real frontend elements, and the visibility conditions allow the rule to run on that page.

Which clipboard formats are included in CMH SmartCopy Lite?

CMH SmartCopy Lite includes Text Only, HTML Only, and Smart Copy.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

Initial public release of CMH SmartCopy Lite.
This version introduces the core copy button workflow for WordPress, including automatic Copy Rules for code blocks, text snippets, and custom selectors. It adds the clipboard formats Text Only, HTML Only, and Smart Copy, along with shared Default Styles for controlling button appearance across rules.
